entries.en:
Jihli Aliapoh, the originator of the Hatching<-->tide festival, has had another of her prophetic dreams, in which she witnessed Riggy the spriggan hiding a fantastically decorated egg. Though whether this alludes to any greater meaning is unclear, Jihli is convinced that, as in previous years, the success of the festival hinges on the reenactment of the events that unfolded in her vision, and to that end, she has requested that Riggy and Nonotta─both fervent supporters of Hatching<-->tide─make preparations for an egg hunt.

※Please note that you will not be able to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, check the Lodestone.

Vous avez discuté avec Jihli Aliapoh, dont une vision a une nouvelle fois provoqué l'or<->ga<->ni<->sa<->tion de la chasse aux Prœufs. Dans son dernier rêve, Riggy cachait un œuf décoré. Elle a im<->mé<->dia<->te<->ment mis son amie Nonotta dans la confidence pour que celle-ci l'aide à réaliser sa prémonition. Rejoignez Nonotta au Nœud, à Nouvelle Gridania, pour tout savoir du déroulement des festivités.

entries.en: Rather than simply hiding eggs around Gridania, Nonotta and Riggy have devised some manner of obscure puzzle, with a map and a series of cryptic clues leading the way. You and Jihli are also given Hatching<-->tide costumes, which despite serving no discernible purpose are nonetheless treated by Nonotta as being an essential part of the festivities. Now it's up to you to embrace your inner spriggan and prepare for the hunt.

entries.en: From atop their giant, decorated eggs they called to me: “Arise, young Dreamer, and make ready the vessels for our return.” When I awoke, I quickly set about filling the realm with all manner of painted ovoids. And thus did this joyous yearly celebration come to be!
entries.fr: C'est un événement festif qui est né juste avant le dernier fléau. J'avais à l'époque fait un rêve trrrès étrange...

entries.fr: Enfin... j'aimerais bien, mais la simple vue de ce papier m'a donné une énorrrme migraine.
entries.ja:
と……言いたいところだけど、
この紙を見ただけじゃ、何が何だかわからないよ……。

entries.en: Oh! I almost forgot the most important part. Three spriggans have been dispatched to various places nearby, and each one will give you a different clue.
entries.fr: C'est normal, l'énigme est indéchiffrable sans indices<nbsp>! Il faut aller en demander un peu plus aux trois spriggans dispersés à Nouvelle Gridania.
entries.ja:
もちろん、その紙だけでは謎を解くことはできません！
新市街のどこかにいる3匹のスプリガンと、
お話しする必要があるのですぅ～！

entries.en: And finally, I've prepared a special egg hunter's costume for you, Jihli! You should wear it to help you get into the spirit of Hatching<-->tide!

entries.fr: Et pour profiter comme il se doit de l'événement, je vous ai préparé de charmants petits costumes<nbsp>! Vous me feriez in<->croya<->ble<->ment plaisir en les enfilant<nbsp>!

さらに、エッグハントを盛り上げるために、
ノノッタがスプリガンを模したお洋服を用意しました！
まずは、ジリちゃんから着てみてほしいのですぅ～！
